title: Execute repository checks in an ephemeral GitHub runner

spec.identity: GitHub Actions runner with contents-read token
spec.boundary: Ephemeral checkout, dependency cache, test scratch and platform run logs; no source write-back or deployment

authorization.scope: Install locked tooling, validate, test and audit
authorization.enforcement: Contents-read token, no persisted checkout credentials, pinned actions, no privileged event or supplied secrets
authorization.deniedBehavior: Fail the job; no auto-fix commit or authority expansion
